attestations.text: LIU Yung 劉墉 (T. 崇如, H. 穆庵, 石庵), 1720–1805, Jan. 24, official and calligrapher, was a native of Chu-ch'êng, Shantung, and son of the Grand Secretary, Liu T'ung-hsün [q. v.]. A chin-shih of 1751, he was a year later appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
